description.value: Queen's Park Arena is a historic indoor ice rink operated by the City of New Westminster, dating to 1930 and seating up to 3,500 spectators. One of the older arenas still in use in Metro Vancouver, it hosts community hockey, skating, and events. A touring cyclist arriving in New Westminster could visit as a heritage sports landmark in the Queen's Park neighbourhood.
